definition: Bacterial Building Blocks: bricks grown by bacteria, not fired.

definition: 2031 milestone on the Bacterial Building Blocks roadmap.

First block hulls product ships at scale: bio-bricks synthesis proven outside the lab.

What must be true first: the bio-bricks results have to replicate outside the lab, block logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and growth chambers operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed bio-bricks demonstrations, block logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting growth chambers uptime. When all three flash green, 2031 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (5 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Bacterial Building Blocks
definition: Estimates Bacterial Building Blocks readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Bacterial Building Blocks components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a block hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Bacterial Building Blocks Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Bacterial Building Blocks operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Bacterial Building Blocks installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 55842 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where bio-bricks monitoring, block logistics redundancy, or growth chambers maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Bacterial Building Blocks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Bacterial Building Blocks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Bacterial Building Blocks — bricks grown by bacteria, not fired.

Phase 1 — Prove (bio-bricks): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (block logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (growth chambers): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (compressive strength): block hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and construction-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
